description:
Checks the taxpayer's completed draft packet for a federal return and, when it passes, holds it as an unsigned draft and returns the link to the filing page; otherwise returns a list of problems to correct. This call files nothing and sends nothing to the IRS: the taxpayer reviews, signs and files on the filing page.

Inputs: the filing session's continuationHandle, completedReturnPacketJson (the whole packet as one JSON string, in this server's packet schema) and packetSchemaSha256 (that schema's digest); other arguments are refused by name. The tax year is return.taxYear=2025 inside the packet. The packet carries the facts the taxpayer stated in this chat and the figures printed on documents the taxpayer gave in it; a fact the taxpayer has not stated is left out rather than written as no, none or 0, and a required fact that is left out comes back as a blocker asking for the taxpayer's answer.

Output: status filing_session_ready with a filingSessionUrl when the packet is accepted; the taxpayer opens that link to give permission, review the return and sign it. Otherwise, blockers (each with a path, a rule and a plain detail) and no link; that packet is not kept, and the same handle accepts a corrected packet. Nothing is filed or charged through a link that expires or is left unfinished, and the same packet sent again with a new filing session's handle returns a fresh link. An accepted packet is held until the taxpayer gives permission on the filing page; declining there, or expiry, erases it. Federal returns: no state, territory or local return is filed. The return has no taxpayer identity fields: the taxpayer's own details go in the packet's separate, required agentIdentity section, which the filing page shows for the taxpayer to confirm. Business identifiers printed on each source form, such as an employer's or payer's name and EIN, are packet fields.

completedReturnPacketJson.description: The complete return packet as one JSON string, in this server's packet schema. Its values are the facts the taxpayer stated and the figures printed on the taxpayer's documents.

packetSchemaSha256.description: The current digest returned by get_packet_schema. The server checks it against the current packet schema; packet-schema-stale means the submitted digest no longer matches that schema.

name: continue_filing_session

readBackToTaxpayer.description: With the filing link: the packet's own answers to the which-apply questions, in plain words, to read to the taxpayer before they open the link.

title: Continue filing session
